insights: The market shows a strong upward trend, with the 7-day average (1512) significantly outpacing the 30-day average (1461), indicating accelerating hiring momentum.
FAANG+ companies are aggressively expanding their new graduate headcount, offsetting the minor contractions seen in the unicorn and 'other' company tiers.

While software engineering remains the dominant category, data engineering is experiencing a notable cooling period, suggesting a shift in focus toward core infrastructure and generalist development roles.
